editorial.blurb: A beloved Chicago sandwich shop and bakery where house-made bread is the real star, paired with creative seasonal sandwiches and an eclectic, welcoming atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Order sandwiches made-to-order and ask about buying their fresh bread by the loaf at affordable prices—many come back specifically for that.
signatureDishes: The Popular (tomato bread with grilled chicken and provolone)
